system.description:
Neural Lullaby: Make an Interface Roll
against a target within Very Close
range. On a success, you flood their
nervous system, cyberware, or sensory
feed with a sedative pulse. They're
Asleep until they take damage or the
GM spends a Fear on their turn to clear
this condition.
Arc Barrage: Once per rest, spend any
number of Hope and fire micro-
missiles, drone shots, smart flechettes,
or compact energy projectiles that
strike a target of your choice within
Close range. Roll a number of d6s
equal to the Hope spent and deal that
much techno damage to the target.
Direct Message: Spend a Hope to open
aline of encrypted communication
with one target you can see. This
connection lasts until your next rest or
you run Direct Message again.
SEE
